gbifID.description: Unique Global Biodiversity Information Facility identifier for each occurrence record.

order.description: Taxonomic order for all records is Passeriformes.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the species, consistently Nectariniidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus for all records, always Cinnyris.

species.description: Species name of the recorded bird, always Cinnyris pulchellus.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No infraspecific epithet data recorded for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, consistently listed as species.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of observed bird species.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: No authorship information recorded for scientific names.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each observation location.

individualCount.description: Individual count field, currently empty for all records.

depth.description: Depth data not provided in this dataset.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy data is absent for all occurrence records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record, ranging from 1986 to 2026.

year.description: Observation year of the record, ranging from 1986 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Taxon identifier linking each record to a specific species classification.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for the recorded species.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source is human observation for all entries.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying the data source, consistently iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: Standard collection identifier, uniformly set to “Observations” for every record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each occurrence observation.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the occurrence record was identified.

license.description: Creative Commons license applied to each occurrence record, indicating usage permissions.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder names of the occurrence records, listed as free‑text identifiers.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each occurrence observation.

typeStatus.description: No type status information is recorded for any occurrence.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data unavailable for all records.
